gloss: at once, in one go, all at once

definitions.gloss: at once, in one go, all at once
definitions.explanation: Doing or achieving something all at one time, in a single action or effort, rather than gradually.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}を{一挙|いっきょ}に{解決|かいけつ}した。
examples.english: I solved the problems all at once.

examples.japanese: {気温|きおん}が{一挙|いっきょ}に{下|さ}がった。
examples.english: The temperature dropped all at once.

examples.japanese: このアプリを{使|つか}えば、{複数|ふくすう}のファイルを{一挙|いっきょ}に{変換|へんかん}できる。
examples.english: With this app, you can convert multiple files all at once.

notes:
USAGE: Emphasizes doing something in a single stroke or burst rather than in stages. It often appears in formal writing and news reporting but is also used in everyday speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一挙|いっきょ}に{解決|かいけつ}する: to resolve all at once
- {一挙|いっきょ}に{片付|かたづ}ける: to deal with everything in one go
- {一挙|いっきょ}に{進|すす}む: to advance all at once

RELATED WORDS:
- {一気|いっき}に: in one breath, in one go (more colloquial)
- {一度|いちど}に: all at one time
- {一挙両得|いっきょりょうとく}: killing two birds with one stone (yojijukugo)
